correctness.rationale: Fourier ODE gives exactly two integrable modes per nonzero frequency; Laguerre orthonormality and tail-moment integration yield the exact matrix. Algebra gives determinant e^{-cz}[2(cosh z-1)-z^2]; \(g'(z)^2-g(z)g''(z)\) is twice a power series with strictly positive coefficients starting at degree six, yielding a unique global maximizer. Quantitative endpoint expansions follow from this root equation; independent quadrature checks passed 387 finite assertions.

value.rationale: For two independent biharmonic channels at fixed horizontal frequency, det M is the squared volume of the restricted two-vector parallelogram and the standard D-optimal simultaneous recovery criterion. The unique frequency maximizing it is an exact natural invariant for every vertical slab. The fourth-order collapse for thin slabs and logarithmic boundary-layer escape reveal distinct geometric conditioning mechanisms rather than a routine single-mode moment evaluation.
